subject: chemistry
content: At 27<sup>o</sup>C, hydrogen is leaked through a tiny hole into a vessel for 20 minutes. Another unknown gas at the same temperature and pressure as that of H<sub>2</sub> is leaked through the same hole for 20 minutes After the effusion of the gases the mixture exerts a pressure of 6 atmosphere. The hydrogen content of the mixture is 0.7 mole. If the volume of ther container is 3 litres, what is the molecular weight of the unknown gas?
